races.title: QuinnBet Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SPARTAN TIMES returns from a short break with his yard continuing in excellent order and given there's still scope from his current mark based on his Flat form, he could be the answer. Lunar Orbit and French recruit Zeus Forlonge head the opposition. SPARTAN TIMES LUNAR ORBIT (IRE) ZEUS FORLONGE (FR)

races.title: Somersby Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Bumper/hurdles winner SPANISH DARLING didn't look out of place when fourth pitched into a Grade 2 on just his second hurdles start at Cheltenham 3 weeks ago, within a length of the lead prior to fluffing his lines at the last. Firmly remaining with his best days ahead of him, he's impossible to oppose returned to much calmer waters. Bumper winner Port Isaac and newcomers Made For Mary and Montevallo may emerge next best. SPANISH DARLING (FR) PORT ISAAC MADE FOR MARY (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Spanish Darling (4/9), Made For Mary (7/1), Montevallo (8/1), Port Isaac (10/1), For Her Glory (14/1), Rose Warrior (20/1), Carrigane (50/1), Ocean View (50/1), Avatar Jet (100/1)

races.title: Carlsberg EBF Mares' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MALINA ROAD laid down solid foundations in a trio of bumper starts last winter, including success at listed level and with this increase in trip promising to suit now hurdling, she shades preference over Boombox who went agonisingly close to making a successful stable/hurdling debut at Worcester recently. Bumper scorer Kentford Legacy hails from a yard in form and also commands a second look, as does Port And Brandy . MALINA ROAD (IRE) BOOMBOX (IRE) KENTFORD LEGACY
races.bettingForecast: Boombox (15/8), Port And Brandy (5/2), Malina Road (3/1), Kentford Legacy (7/1), Crystal Connemara (14/1), Millady (20/1), Britway Belle (50/1)

races.title: Karina's 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: CHAMBERS is well treated on his Flat form and having won his latest start in that sphere, he's fancied to make a successful handicap hurdle debut. Arcon didn't immediately improve on his handicap bow but looks capable of making an impact in this sort of company, whilst Prince Phil can improve handicapping. CHAMBERS (IRE) ARCON (GER) PRINCE PHIL

races.title: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A trappy mares handicap which can go the way of the experienced IRISH CHORUS , who did well in this sphere last season and was unable to recover from a late blunder on her recent comeback. Lau And Shaz had a positive time of things over hurdles last campaign and should prove at least as good over fences, whilst Lady Tadita should also benefit from her initial experience chasing. IRISH CHORUS LAU AND SHAZ (IRE) LADY TADITA
races.bettingForecast: Pismo Beach (7/4), Lady Tadita (11/4), Lau And Shaz (3/1), Irish Chorus (4/1)

races.title: Hobgoblin Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ORDEROFTHEDAY ought to relish this step back up in trip, and he's taken to make it 2 wins from 3 starts over fences. Kahavari will be suited by speed-favouring conditions and just edges Kalhandrion for next best. ORDEROFTHEDAY (IRE) KAHAVARI (FR) KALHANDRION (FR)

races.title: 1664 Biere Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: JIMMY GATZ is well worth another chance to build on his strong debut form having probably found testing conditions against him at Ffos Las when last seen (Flat bred). Bateleur went down fighting on his Rules debut at Sedgefield last month and his excellent attitude is sure to stand him in good stead again, while the selection's stablemate, Hannah's Kitchen , is the pick of the newcomers before market clues. JIMMY GATZ (FR) BATELEUR (IRE) HANNAH'S KITCHEN (IRE)
